coordinate_frame: Original output/sw-probe/arm.glb global frame, right handed, +Y up. Same orientation and origin as SW arm assembly; web GLB preserves it.
motor_policy: Complete source motor assemblies; rigid translation with the owning link, no internal separation.
belt_policy: CAD tooth segments joined into one belt part per link and belt specification.
explosion_policy: Ordered L1-L6 link separation with small transverse plate/tooth offsets. Fasteners follow the nearest mounting body. A visual diagram, not a collision-free service sequence.

quality_policy.protected: Motors, carbon, gears and pulleys retain cleaned source tessellation.
quality_policy.normals: 35 degree smoothing; area-weighted planar normals except motors.
